## Workload

Elif Sahin completed 914 reads during the quarter. This work required 435 hours, giving an average output of 2.1 reads per hour. The volume reviewed reflects a sustained workload across the period, with the available reading time applied consistently to the assigned material.

## Quality

A further 61 reads were checked as part of the quality review. The level of agreement was 78.7 per cent. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support consistency in the application of the grading approach and to clarify areas where interpretation could vary.

The review was completed by Priya Anand.
